Synopsis:
    US equity markets sold off modestly as a hotter-than-expected August PPI print (5.4% annualized vs. 5.3% expected) reinforced rate hike expectations ahead of Friday's CPI release. Oil above $100/bbl on Middle East supply disruptions added inflationary pressure. The 10-year Treasury yield hit 4.92% (highest since 2023), weighing on equities. Fed hike probability for the upcoming meeting rose to 69.8% (from ~64%). Treasury buybacks of up to $6B in longer-dated bonds failed to meaningfully suppress yields. Markets are in a defensive posture awaiting CPI as a potential pivot catalyst.
